sources.snippet: GR00T N1.6 + HAMLET + Persistent TTT — RoboMME NMT T=4 Private archival checkpoint for Nuri's persistent test-time-training experiment on RoboMME. It extends the HAMLET K=4 attention-memory policy with recurrent fast weights trained using a next-moment-token inner objective.
